authority.required_future_action: A director must grant positive cumulative spend and assign a compatible lab bench before this contract may execute.

materialization_rule: Before any future claim, snapshot every consumed candidate, oracle, contract, pinned-runtime source, exact qualified hidden-state fixture/tree metadata, and build script under this project; hash the immutable manifest and transfer only that project-local snapshot. Do not resolve shared source or fixture paths after claim.

candidate.target_implementation: A CUTLASS/CuTe SM90a BF16 BM64xBN256 no-split-K GEMM mainloop whose epilogue rounds each output exactly to stock BF16, converts to FP32, applies softcap and tile-local processors in pinned order, and writes one (value,lowest_id) partial per output row and vocab tile. A 32-CTA request reducer consumes 12x1024 partials, reproduces VerifyTreeGreedy, and emits predicts/accept_indices/num_correct_drafts to unchanged _fill_requests/_free_cache.
candidate.fallback: Call the exact pinned materialized LogitsProcessor/NgramVerifyInput path for non-greedy sampling, custom processors, return_logprob/top-logprobs/token-logprobs, non-tile-local processors, or TP greater than one.
path_proof: Loaded shared-object SHA-256 and exact sm90a cubin/function identity
A monotonic invocation counter inside the candidate producer and request reducer
A fallback-reason counter proving zero fallback rows in the qualified temperature-zero arm
One untimed debug call that records per-tile BF16-rounded/post-softcap partials and final row IDs

smoke.first_target_call: Fresh process, exact pinned lm_head bytes, M=1/K5376/N262144, one vocab tile boundary tie and one softcap-saturation tie; synchronize immediately after candidate producer and reducer.
smoke.pass: Bitwise stock selected ID, finite partials, lowest-ID tie parity, candidate path counters exactly one, no fallback, no spill/launch/resource failure.
smoke.disposition: Repair ordinary compile/API/layout defects in the retained claimed session; do not classify or release on a pre-result launcher failure.

component_arms.control: Pinned Gemma4 LogitsProcessor._compute_lm_head through NgramVerifyInput.verify, _fill_requests, and _free_cache with the full FP32 logits materialized.
component_arms.candidate: Same captured hidden states, tied weight, sampling/tree/penalty/grammar metadata, out_cache_loc, request state, stream, and graph regime through the fused producer/reducer and unchanged fill/free consumers.
component_arms.timing: Profiler off, warm caches, alternating A/B/A/B/A/B/A after at least 20 warmups; at least 100 timed iterations per repetition using CUDA events. Each timing is one full batch-level producer-to-first-KV-commit invocation.
component_arms.persistence: Atomically persist each repetition's control/candidate raw samples, oracle state, path counters, and expected-row ledger before the next repetition.

required_bitwise_equal: accepted token IDs and output_ids append order
finish reason and first finished token
required_numerical_debug_equal: final per-row argmax value and ID
fallback_tests: temperature=0.73/top_k=17/top_p=0.82 routes to stock and matches sampled acceptance
correctness_gate.failure: Any mismatch rejects the candidate before timing.

performance_gate.primary: Candidate median producer-to-first-KV-commit latency must be lower than stock and the paired 95% bootstrap interval for candidate minus control must be wholly below zero.
performance_gate.causal_gate: Full-logit global stores must be absent and measured DRAM or L2 write traffic must fall consistently with the 2,006,971,392-byte logical-interface model; otherwise the traffic mechanism is falsified even if timing noise is favorable.
performance_gate.report_units: Keep batch-wave delta. Normalize to requests only as delta_per_batch_call * measured_physical_calls / 32 completed requests; also report the unnormalized batch total.
performance_gate.component_promotion: Any correctness-passing positive component is stackable evidence. A matched endpoint requires a separate director decision because this contract has no spend authority.
